data.one_liner: Adds text or image watermarks to images with customizable position and color.
data.what_it_does: Provides static methods to overlay text or another image onto a source image. You can set watermark position, size, and color using pure Dart code.
use_when: You need to add static watermarks to photos or graphics in a Flutter app
You want a pure‑Dart solution that works on mobile, web, and desktop without native plugins
avoid_when: You require real‑time video watermarking or high‑performance processing
You need advanced editing features like filters, layers, or PDF watermarking
strengths: No native dependencies, easy to add
weaknesses: Limited to basic watermarking, no advanced editing
Relies on the image package which can be memory‑heavy for large files
No streaming or async pipeline support

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: General‑purpose image manipulation library that can also draw text or overlay images

data.minimal_example: final watermarkedImg = await ImageWatermark.addTextWatermark(imgBytes: imgBytes, watermarktext: 'watermarkText', dstX: 20, dstY: 30, color: Colors.green);
